query:
SELECT g.id
        FROM agents g
        JOIN human_accounts a ON a.id = $1 AND a.active
        WHERE g.id = $2
          AND (
            a.role = 'administrator'
            OR EXISTS(
                SELECT 1
                FROM effective_human_grants p
                WHERE p.actor_id = a.id
                  AND p.scope_kind = 'agent'
                  AND p.scope_id = g.id
                  AND p.capability = 'agent.manage'
            )
          )
        FOR UPDATE OF g
